# Teacher OS
Preserve the canonical flow: Curriculum -> Scheme -> Lesson -> Lesson Plan -> Lesson Notes/Resources -> Attendance/Teaching -> Learner Work -> Marking/Assessment -> Evidence/Reflection/Progress -> Next Lesson. Prefer prefill and reuse of existing lesson/curriculum/homework evidence over new teacher data entry. Verify class/school/subject identity, persistence, navigation, history/search where needed, mobile usability, and downstream learner/parent effects. Do not create duplicate lesson/progress/resource sources of truth.
